purpose: Ask whether the fixed reader's target-free program-effect prediction composes with MLP15/17 through a small direction-by-cardinality scalar gain law, using leave-one-row-out prediction before any fourth-corpus export.

prior_art_search.result: Existing results establish the ten-vector upstream program, fixed readers, grouped mediation, and the exact MLP15/17 split. None predicts MLP15/17 mediation from the fixed reader with a row-held-out scalar composition law.

model.input: the already sealed fixed-reader prediction q_hat for each installed direction-cardinality vector
model.fit: For each held row and component c in {m15,m17,interaction}, fit one zero-intercept scalar a[c,d,k] on all other rows of the same direction d and cardinality k; predict c=a*q_hat.
model.size: 30 scalar gains plus the already frozen ten 1,152-D writes and two 1,152-D readers
model.control: six direction-only component gains under the identical leave-one-row-out folds

predictions.pred_a_exact_join_and_row_holdout: Exactly 512 unique cells join immutable sealed-reader and mediation evidence; every prediction excludes all cells from its row; all direction-cardinality folds have training support.
predictions.pred_b_mlp15_predictive: LOO m15 prediction has cosine >=0.75, relative L2 error <=0.75, and sign agreement >=0.65.
predictions.pred_c_mlp17_predictive: LOO m17 prediction has cosine >=0.90, relative L2 error <=0.40, and sign agreement >=0.90.
predictions.pred_d_joint_mediation_predictive: LOO reconstructed joint mediation has cosine >=0.90, relative L2 error <=0.40, sign agreement >=0.90, and cosine >=0.85 in every direction x template group.
predictions.pred_e_cardinality_is_needed: Direction-by-cardinality gains reduce joint-mediation SSE by >=10% relative to direction-only gains under identical row-held-out folds.
predictions.pred_f_fixed_price_and_scope: CPU-only exact diagnostic, 512 predictions, 30 stored candidate scalars, zero GPU/model forwards, gradients, updates, scales, or threshold changes after scoring.

terminal_rule: Invalid if a or f fails; prototype_gain_screen if b-e all pass; null if instrument passes and d fails; otherwise inconclusive.
